description: How one NFL player does in a spot, and whether it holds up: home vs road, against one opponent, indoors vs outdoors, in the cold (40°F or below), in prime time, division games, vs man or zone coverage and vs the blitz (QBs, since 2023), against his former teams, the game after a bad one, rookie season, and backup QB starts (league-wide when no player is named). Works for QBs (EPA per dropback, passing yards, TDs, picks, completions), running backs (rushing yards, carries, rushing + receiving yards) and receivers and tight ends (receiving yards, receptions, targets, anytime TD). Answers first with the raw split: per-game average on each side, n and a 95% interval, plus career, this-season and recent baselines. Then a holds_up block: how much splits of that kind repeat year to year for NFL players since 2018, how much of his gap survives, and an estimate for his next game in that spot. Give a prop (e.g. 'over 265.5 passing yards -115') to get the hit rate, win chance, fair price and EV. Also returns his team's straight-up, against-the-spread and over/under record in those games. For 'Goff at home vs away', 'Cousins vs the Bears', 'Tua in the cold', 'Allen against the blitz', 'Stafford vs the Lions', 'backup QB starts ATS', 'Lamb receiving yards at home', 'Henry over 89.5 rushing yards', 'player prop', 'QB splits'.

metric.description: Stat to split on. Defaults by position: QB EPA per dropback (passing yards when a prop is given), RB rushing yards, WR/TE receiving yards.

opponent.description: Opponent team for an opponent split, or to narrow any split to games against one team.

player.description: Player name, e.g. Jared Goff, Goff, CeeDee Lamb. Leave out only for league-wide rookie or backup QB starts.

prop.description: A prop in plain words, e.g. 'over 265.5 passing yards -115' or 'under 4.5 receptions +105'.

split.description: Which split (default home_away, or opponent when an opponent is given).

venue.description: For home_away: which side to lead with. For other splits: only home or only road games.

name: player_split
title: Player splits and props: home vs away, vs a team, in the cold, prime time, vs the blitz
